messages:
Rae (CSM): Orbit Labs (acct: orbit-314) flagged: trial day 12, only did token test and one embeddings call. Health down to 41. not great before renewal. :rotating_light:
MetricsBot: Triggered rule 'trial_idle_then_embed' -> health 68 -> 41 at 1765439991.
Rae (CSM): Idea: run an "orbit rescue" flow: tight 30m engineer pairing, short checklist, $350 onboarding credit, and a customer feedback capture (4 quick fields). If still blocked, offer a transparent downgrade broker path so they don't get surprised on billing.
Theo (AM): good. explicit downgrade broker language please. customers hate feeling "locked in."
Ivy (Enablement): I can run the 30m pairing. Agenda I use works well: 1) 3-min goal alignment 2) 12-min walk-through + run 3) 10-min troubleshoot 4) 5-min next steps/metrics. Ill prep a one-page cheat sheet.
Mika (Support): I'll open SUP-8809 for pairing ops and attach recent 401/429 samples. who owns the staging key exchange?
Rae (CSM): I'll DM staging workspace link. please require staging keys for pairing and paste steps in SUP-8809.
Sam (CS Ops): $350 credit approved. Please include acceptance criteria in CSOPS ticket and mark as non-refundable unless infra outage. Also please record the expected KPI: first 3 successful calls + health >= 60 within 7 days.
Rae (CSM): Draft downgrade broker offer: 1) 30-day "safety pause" (trial extended, no billing), 2) Optional "Starter Core" with reduced quota and pro-rated price, 3) One-time 20% discount to move to paid Starter in first cycle, 4) 7-day office-hours support window. This is communicated as an opt-in email with clear accept/decline links.
Theo (AM): Can we get legal to pre-approve the opt-in wording? I want it short and transparent.
Mika (Support): SUP-8809 created and assigned to eng-oncall. log snippet pasted: ```{"time":"2026-03-01T14:11:22Z","err":"invalid_token","req":"req_x13"}```
Ivy (Enablement): Pairing snippet I'll use: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"small-emb","input":["a","b"]}'```
Rae (CSM): Feedback form fields: 1) primary blocker (choices: auth, docs, SDK, infra), 2) did pairing resolve it? (yes/no), 3) ease score (1-5), 4) verbatim notes. Paste verbatim into SUP-8809.
Orbit Labs: Quick Q: If we take the Starter Core option later, will our data remain accessible? we need clarity on retention.
Rae (CSM): Yes — Starter Core retains read-only access to indexed embeddings + docs for 90 days. We'll put exact retention in the opt-in link.
Theo (AM): KPI: health >= 60 and first inference + index created within 7 days. If not achieved, AM will follow up for pricing concession discussion.
Sam (CS Ops): Also adding account flag "orbit_rescue_active" = true start_ts=1765439991 for reporting.
Orbit Labs: We prefer async first (short clip). our infra folks are in a sprint this week. can you send the clip and the one-pager?
Ivy (Enablement): Sure — fallback = 12-min async clip + repo + $175 credit. Live pairing preferred but we can deliver async within 24h.
Mika (Support): I'll add SDK version verification to SUP-8809 (require >=2.4.0).
MetricsBot: Post-intervention health probe scheduled at 1765442591 (+1h after pairing) and 1765516991 (+7d).
Rae (CSM): Action owners: Rae = customer outreach + opt-in email + paste feedback; Ivy = run pairing/prepare async clip; Mika = SUP-8809 + logs; Sam = credit ticket + account flag; Theo = escalation owner + legal coordination.
Rae (CSM): Outreach sent: "Hi Orbit Labs  noticed a stall; would you like a 30m pairing or a short async clip to get embeddings running? We have a starter credit and a safety-pause option if needed. Link to opt-in + staging instructions included."
Orbit Labs: Thanks Rae  async clip first please. staging keys only.
Ivy (Enablement): I'll upload the clip and one-pager and paste links here once done.
Rae (CSM): Closing loop for now. Please paste session notes and verbatim feedback into SUP-8809. If KPIs not met at 7d, Theo will trigger next-step negotiation. thanks team :rocket:
